{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check the unique values in the 'arm' column to confirm the arms
print(trial_df['arm'].unique())

# Check the unique values in the 'responded' column to confirm response status
print(trial_df['responded'].unique())

# Check for missing values in the 'responded' column
print(trial_df['responded'].isnull().sum())

# Check the distribution of 'responded' in the treatment arm
treatment_arm = trial_df[trial_df['arm'] == 'treatment']
print(f"Number of patients in treatment arm: {len(treatment_arm)}")
print(f"Number of responders in treatment arm: {treatment_arm['responded'].sum()}")

# Compute the fraction of responders in the treatment arm
treatment_responders = treatment_arm['responded'].sum()
treatment_total = len(treatment_arm)
fraction_responded = treatment_responders / treatment_total

fraction_responded"}
